videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
videos.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
videos.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
videos.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
videos.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.
